sloka: स निकृत्तौ भुजौ दृष्ट्वा शोणित ओघ परिप्लुतः ।दीनः पप्रच्छ तौ वीरौ कौ युवाम् इति दानवः ॥३-७०-११॥
transliteration: sa nikṛttau bhujau dṛṣṭvā śoṇita ogha pariplutaḥ ।dīnaḥ papraccha tau vīrau kau yuvām iti dānavaḥ ॥3-70-11॥

translations.english: The demon with his arms amputated, drenched in a pool of blood looked pathetic and asked them, Who are you?
